# SD18 deterministic Human Paladin level 18 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 level-17 fixture
# (tests/sd18_paladin_level17_widening.rs) to level 18 as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic Longsword / Chain
# Shirt / no-shield / Power Attack posture, and the level-3..level-17
# fixture's five mercy selections unchanged (choice:paladin_mercy ->
# mercy:shaken, choice:paladin_mercy_4 -> mercy:blinded,
# choice:paladin_mercy_5 -> mercy:deafened) -- 18th IS a
# repeat-mercy-grant level (the 3rd/6th/9th/12th/15th/18th cadence), so a
# SIXTH mercy selection (choice:paladin_mercy_6 -> mercy:sickened, the
# next unpicked tier-3 condition) is added.
#
# The PF1 CRB Paladin class table's level-18 "Special" column reads
# "Mercy" ONLY (verified independently against d20pfsrd and the Archives
# of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, both agreeing byte-for-byte) -- a repeat
# grant, mirroring the level-6/9/12/15 mercy-slot idiom exactly: no new
# named mercy-list tier is added (the CRB's named mercy conditions stop
# growing after 12th level), only a sixth pick from the already-existing
# pool, recognized as a bounded +0 choice-slot record.
#
# The base spells-per-day table's level-18 row is "4/3/2/2" (verified
# independently against both sources): the 1st/2nd/3rd-level columns
# stay 4/3/2 unchanged, and the 4th-level column genuinely rises from 1
# to 2.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell
# selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no mercy
# EFFECT resolution, no channel positive energy healing/damage-resolution
# execution, no Divine Bond (weapon bond / mount bond) selection or
# execution, no Aura of Justice's own smite-sharing resolution, no Aura
# of Faith's own good-alignment-weapon-treatment resolution, no Aura of
# Righteousness's own damage-reduction/compulsion-immunity resolution,
# and no level-19+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-paladin-level18
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:paladin:18
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:diplomacy:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
choice=choice:paladin_mercy:mercy:shaken
choice=choice:paladin_mercy_4:mercy:blinded
choice=choice:paladin_mercy_5:mercy:deafened
choice=choice:paladin_mercy_6:mercy:sickened
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
